create_benchmark_from_bitcode_file: create a Benchmark from an LLVM bitcode file using Benchmark.from_file with a custom URI
create_benchmark_from_file_contents: create a Benchmark from raw bitcode bytes using Benchmark.from_file_contents with a custom URI
make_benchmark_from_source: build a Benchmark from a C source file using llvm.make_benchmark and reset the environment
make_benchmark_from_command_line: create a Benchmark from a gcc command line string using env.make_benchmark_from_command_line
reset_env_with_custom_benchmark: reset an LlvmEnv with a custom Benchmark to switch to a new compilation target
